_about: Additive bridge between the feature store name::season shard keys and the crosswalk player_key. byNameKey maps a shard key ("<normalized_name>::<season>") to its stable player_key; byPlayerKey maps "<player_key>::<season>" back to the shard key so features can be looked up by canonical identity. Regenerated by build-player-crosswalk.py from the same resolution used to build the crosswalk; do not hand-edit.
